ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of funds in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including how the suspects embezzled the funds and where the funds were laundered.
questions: How did the suspects embezzle the funds?
ideas.insight: This story would provide a detailed analysis of the financial transactions involved in the fraud scheme, which could help identify patterns and connections between the suspects and other entities.
